headline: Google has been confirmed as the company behind a proposed data centre at the Wood Haven Technology Park in Roanoke County, Virginia.
score_reason: Pool 5 kept: a confirmed Google project that local leaders call historic, but it is still in an evaluation stage with no size given.
importance_line: Roanoke-area residents and the three local governments that own the site could gain construction jobs and community funding, but water use, power supply and environmental reviews are still being studied and Google has not committed to build.
summary: WDBJ7 reports that the Western Virginia Regional Industrial Facility Authority confirmed on 16 Oct 2026 that Google, operating as Clearview Dynamics, is evaluating the 94-acre Wood Haven Technology Park in Roanoke County for a potential data centre, in a due diligence period expected to run through March 2027. Roanoke County Administrator Richard Caywood said it would be the largest industrial project in the county's history, and the site would draw its water from Spring Hollow Reservoir.
notes: Read in full (the pool link was the AMP version). Google is evaluating only; no size or investment figure is stated.
